Boundary faces have sharp normalized sixth moment at most \(5/2\), while the aligned equal-modulus interior point has \(11/3\), so every global maximizer is interior. The stationarity equations reduce exactly to the stated rational formula for \(X\) and the degree-ten polynomial \(R\). The packaged standard-library verifier constructs the Sturm chain with exact rational arithmetic and proves that \(R\) has exactly one root in the entire feasible interval, then reconstructs the unique moduli and all phase-equality cases.

value.rationale: The support \(\{0,1,3\}\) is the classical Hardy--Littlewood three-term support, and exponent \(6\) is its first cubic-resonant even norm. The exact unrestricted coefficient-\(\ell^2\)-to-\(L^6\) constant is a natural invariant of this Fourier subspace. Its optimizer is genuinely non-unimodular, so the result exposes structure not visible in phase-only formulas; the exact all-extremizer classification makes it more than a numerical optimization.
